key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:058E
name: delay_15000_then_call
description: Runs a fixed delay of 15000 steps, then calls a routine with the first argument, and returns.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:05A8
name: seek_to_track_position
description: Returns zero when the record is already at the requested position. Otherwise it sets or clears the side-select bit when the parity of the two positions differs, moves the head one step per call toward the target in the direction chosen by a control bit, pauses for 15000 steps, stores the new position in the record and returns the result of a final routine call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:05F6
name: seek_track_from_frame_args
description: Moves the head like the seek routine, but takes the current and target positions and the side from the caller's frame. It sets or clears the side-select bit when the sides differ, steps toward the target one step per call, pauses for 15000 steps, stores the new position in the record and calls a routine on the record.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0622
name: seek_with_fixed_side_setup
description: Sets the side-select bit and pauses for 200 steps, then moves the head toward the target position from the caller's frame one step per call. It pauses for 15000 steps, stores the new position in the record and calls a routine on the record.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0666
name: step_head_and_store_position
description: Sets the direction bit, moves the head one step per call for the difference between two frame positions, pauses for 15000 steps, then stores the new position in the record and calls a routine on the record.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:069A
name: settle_and_store_track_position
description: Pauses for 15000 steps, stores the position from the caller's frame in the record, and calls a routine on the record.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:06BE
name: update_control_byte_from_inputs
description: Updates a global control byte from two input bytes: it sets bit 7, clears every bit that is set in the first input, and clears bit 7 when the low bit of the second input is set.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0700
name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Sets bits three to six of a global control byte and leaves the other bits unchanged.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0718
name: delay_loop_quarter_count
description: Divides its argument by four and calls a routine once for each step of a countdown loop with that count, then returns.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0740
name: set_control_bit_and_pause
description: Sets bit zero of a global control byte, then pauses for 3000 steps.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:076C
name: start_disk_dma_and_wait
description: Points disk DMA at the record's buffer, clears the disk-block interrupt request, and starts a read transfer when a global flag bit is set. It then polls the interrupt request for up to 200000 steps, returning 22 on timeout, 25 when the flag was clear, and 0 on success.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0800
name: poll_status_bit_with_limit
description: Counts down while checking a flag byte in its frame for the bit with value 2. When that bit is set it clears a word in the record, stores 25 as the result unless a global flag bit is set, passes its argument to a called routine and returns that result. If the count runs out first it returns 22.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:084C
name: set_record_flag_if_clear
description: Returns at once if the flag byte of the record passed in is already nonzero. Otherwise it sets that flag to 1, passes the record to a called routine twice, and calls the same routine once with the constant 500000.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:085E
name: set_record_flag_unconditionally
description: Sets the flag byte of the record named in the arguments to 1 without testing it first. It then passes the record to a called routine twice and calls that routine once with the constant 500000.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:088A
name: clear_record_flag_if_set
description: Returns at once if the flag byte of the record is zero. Otherwise it clears the byte and passes the record to a called routine twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:089C
name: clear_record_flag_and_notify
description: Clears the flag byte in the record named by the parameter, then passes that record to a called routine twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:08BA
name: locate_sync_word_start
description: Scans forward through 16-bit words for the disk sync word value, stopping once the scan passes the given byte length. When it finds one it returns a pointer two words before it if a second sync word follows, otherwise three words before it, and a null pointer if none is found.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:08F4
name: step_back_six_bytes
description: Reads a pointer from a local slot of the caller's frame and returns it moved back by six bytes. It writes no memory and has no loop.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0900
name: scan_forward_for_sync_word
description: Advances a stored read pointer two bytes at a time until it reaches the disk sync word value, returning a null pointer when it passes the end bound. On a match it returns a pointer two words earlier if a second sync word follows, otherwise three words earlier.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:090C
name: encode_and_verify_track_sectors
description: Writes two padding words and a sync word at the start of a sector header in the buffer, stores that position in the caller's structure and fills in the header fields. It then verifies eleven sectors by comparing each stored check value with a checksum over its 1024-byte block, returning zero on success or a failure code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0934
name: encode_sectors_from_sync_offset
description: Chooses the header start in the buffer by checking for a sync word at a fixed offset, then writes padding and sync words there and stores that position in the caller's structure. It then verifies eleven sectors the same way, comparing each stored check value with a checksum over its 1024-byte block, and returns zero on success or a failure code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:094C
name: encode_sectors_at_fixed_offset
description: Writes padding and sync words at a header position six bytes before a pointer held in the frame, then stores that position in the caller's structure. It then verifies eleven sectors by comparing each stored check value with a checksum over its 1024-byte block, returning zero on success or a failure code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:09FC
name: verify_all_sector_checksums
description: Clears a result word in the record, then checks eleven sectors in order. Each sector's stored check value is compared with a checksum over its 1024-byte block; the routine returns the called routine's error code when that is nonzero, a failure code on mismatch, or zero when all sectors pass.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0A88
name: verify_remaining_sector_checksums
description: Steps a sector index forward and checks each sector up to the eleventh, comparing its stored check value with a checksum over its 1024-byte block. It returns a failure code on the first mismatch and passes back any nonzero error from the called routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0A90
name: return_stored_result_code
description: Returns the result value held in a local slot of the caller's frame without doing anything else.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0A98
name: compute_sector_base_address
description: Returns the memory address of a numbered sector by stepping forward from the track's starting address in 1088-byte increments. The walk switches to a second base address once a sector count taken from the record runs out, and the sector index wraps after ten.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0ACC
name: step_to_target_sector
description: Moves an address forward in 1088-byte steps, tracking the sector index and wrapping it after ten, until the index equals the requested sector. It returns the address reached, switching to a second base address when its count runs out.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B04
name: validate_sector_header_fields
description: Confirms a sync word at the header position, then checks that a 40-byte block checksum matches its stored copy, the leading marker byte holds the expected value, the header's track byte equals the record's number, and the sector index is below eleven with a count from one to eleven. It returns zero when all pass and a distinct failure code for each check that fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B1E
name: check_sector_header_from_frame
description: Validates a sector header with the same checks as the header validation routine, but reads its arguments from the caller's frame. It stores the failure code in a local slot and returns zero when every check passes.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B54
name: check_header_fields_no_checksum
description: Checks a header's marker byte, track byte, sector index and sector count, without the 40-byte checksum comparison. It returns zero when all pass, otherwise the failure code for the first check that fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B68
name: check_sector_track_and_count
description: Checks that a header's track byte matches the record's number, its sector index is below eleven and its count is between one and eleven. It returns zero when all pass, otherwise a failure code for the first check that fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B88
name: check_sector_index_and_count
description: Checks that a header's sector index is below eleven and its count is between one and eleven. It returns zero when both pass, seven when the index is too large and eight when the count is out of range.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0B9E
name: check_sector_count_range
description: Checks that a header's count byte is between one and eleven. It returns zero when it is, otherwise the failure code eight.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0BB8
name: return_zero_status
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0BBE
name: compute_masked_xor_checksum
description: XORs together the 32-bit words of a block, using its byte length divided by four as the word count, and keeps only the even-numbered bits of the result. The masked value is returned as a check value for the block.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0BEA
name: mask_stored_even_bits
description: Returns a value held in a local slot of the caller's frame with only its even-numbered bits kept.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:1:0CF0
name: merge_even_odd_bit_fields
description: Takes a pointer to two 32-bit words and keeps the even-numbered bits of each. It moves the first word's kept bits up one position and ORs them with the second word's kept bits, returning the combined value.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0000
name: create_io_request_block
description: Creates an unnamed message port through the port-creation routine and stores its address in the caller's structure. It also stores 56 in a size field, the same size that the matching delete routine releases.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0024

description: Deletes the message port stored in the structure and frees the 56-byte block holding the structure. It returns zero.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0054
name: read_sectors_via_io_request
description: Fills an I/O request for a read by setting the command to 2, the address to the given value with its lowest bit cleared, the offset to the sector number times 512 and the length to the sector count times 512. It then runs the request and waits for it to finish.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:009A
name: write_sectors_via_io_request
description: Fills an I/O request for a write by setting the command to 3 and the address, offset and length exactly as the read routine does. It then runs the request and waits for it to finish.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:00E0
name: format_sectors_with_prechecks
description: Sets up an I/O request with command 11 for a sector offset and length, then runs two checks on it. It returns 1 or 2 if the first or second check fails, otherwise it runs the request and returns its result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:012E
name: run_io_after_check
description: Runs one check on the request in the caller's frame and returns 2 if it fails. Otherwise it runs that request synchronously and returns its result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0144
name: run_io_request_directly
description: Runs the synchronous I/O request whose pointer is held in the caller's frame and returns nothing.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0154
name: run_zero_length_io_command
description: Clears the address, offset and length fields of the request, sets its command to 4, and runs it synchronously. It returns nothing.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:0182
name: stop_drive_motor_request
description: Clears the address, offset and length fields of the request, sets its command to 9, and runs it synchronously.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts).adf:Zany:4:01B0
name: run_selected_command_result
description: Clears the address, offset and length fields of the request, sets its command from the second argument, runs it synchronously and returns the request's result field.

description: Stores register-supplied values and a signal into an existing message port and records the current task as its owner. It then initializes the port's message list or adds the port to a list.
